cms_event.description: Calendar event blocks attached to CMS nodes. A node can have multiple cms_event records, each representing one fixed block with its own start and exclusive end.

start.description: Inclusive start in epoch milliseconds. Whole calendar days use UTC midnight coordinates with all_day set.

end.description: Exclusive end in epoch milliseconds. Whole calendar days use UTC midnight coordinates with all_day set.

all_day.description: True for whole calendar days; derived from date-only boundaries when a block is written.
